verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is an AI agent product, so multi-agent orchestration is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents subagents, swarms, an agent-to-agent protocol, or splitting work in parallel. 'Agent Flows' and 'custom agent workflows' appear only as bare titles with no indication that multiple agents cooperate, so they are at most adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work
